summary: First iteration — full backend + frontend test of Captain Culinary Kids. All 12 backend pytest tests pass (health, lessons, badges, missions, progress roundtrip, food-truck/restaurant builders persist & retrieve). Frontend flows verified end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844): Welcome → Age Selection (4 cards, persists ageGroup) → Dashboard (bottom nav present, content renders) → Lesson Library (filters work) → Live Teaching Plate (mirepoix plate SVG, Captain narration, 4 action buttons, Move On advances 5 steps to quiz) → Quiz (3 questions × 3 choices, submit + result panel) → Progress (10 badges grid). Family Challenge (6 cards), Global Food Mission (6 cards + modal open/close), Food Truck Builder (10 fields → saves concept card + earns 'food-truck-rookie' badge), Restaurant Builder (10 fields → 'restaurant-builder' badge), Parent/Teacher Info, Settings (4 age path buttons, sound + reminders switches, reset confirm flow exists in code) all functional.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicks on the rightmost two nav items (Progress and Parent) do not navigate in the preview environment because the 'Made with Emergent' platform badge sits at the bottom-right corner with higher z-index and intercepts clicks. The links themselves are wired correctly (href set, pointerEvents:auto, routes work via direct URL). Real production users without the Emergent badge will be unaffected, but this should still be hardened — recommend raising z-index of `.cck-bottomnav` above the badge, OR adding bottom padding/margin to the nav so badge doesn't overlap the rightmost two links. elementFromPoint at center of nav-progress returned 'none', confirming overlay obstruction.

action_items: Optional: raise z-index of bottom nav (or add right padding) so 'Made with Emergent' preview badge does not overlap nav-progress/nav-parent in preview environment.

Documentation: review_request used a few inaccurate data-testid names. Actual code uses: lesson-ask-question-btn (not lesson-ask-btn), lesson-explain-again-btn (not lesson-explain-btn), lesson-biblical-btn (not lesson-life-connection-btn), quiz-q{i}-choice-{ci} (not quiz-choice-*), library-card-{id}/library-start-{id} (not lesson-card-*/lesson-start-btn-*), settings-sound-switch (not settings-sound-toggle), ask-captain-input/ask-captain-submit/ask-captain-close, ft-input-{key}/ft-save-btn, rb-input-{key}/rb-save-btn. Code is correct; only the spec naming differs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: clean, async, uuid IDs, MongoDB _id excluded — good.
Missing CORS_ORIGINS handling: backend reads CORS_ORIGINS but defaults to '*' which is fine for demo.
Backend route /api/progress/{session_id} GET returns ProgressDoc.model_dump() including a datetime updatedAt field — datetime serializes via FastAPI's jsonable_encoder, so OK.
FoodTruckConcept.id auto-generated server-side via uuid — but client also sends payload without id; works.
Frontend: LiveTeachingPlate.jsx hooks-before-early-return rule respected (verified — useState/useEffect at top). Good.
Reset flow in Settings.jsx is well-implemented with confirm step.
No file > 700 lines; modular structure is good.
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes; consistent naming pattern.
Captain image radial mask + mix-blend-mode multiply renders cleanly on parchment background.
lessons.js is single source of truth on FE; backend mirrors it — keep them in sync going forward.
test_credentials: None — app is anonymous. localStorage key: cck.state.v1
seed_data_creation: Tests created TEST_-prefixed food_truck and restaurant docs in MongoDB under TEST_<uuid> sessionIds; no production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_captain_culinary_api.py — reuse for regression. Correct frontend testids documented in action_items. The only real concern is the 'Made with Emergent' badge overlapping nav-progress/nav-parent in preview — direct URL navigation works fine; routes are wired correctly. All core flows (welcome, age, dashboard, lesson teaching plate, quiz, progress, builders, settings) function end-to-end with localStorage persistence and best-effort backend sync.
rca of the issue: Bottom-nav rightmost-two-links not clickable in preview: ROOT CAUSE = 'Made with Emergent' overlay badge in bottom-right corner has higher stacking context than the .cck-bottomnav, so document.elementFromPoint at the center of nav-progress/nav-parent returns null/the badge container. Reproduction: open any /dashboard in preview viewport 390x844, click [data-testid='nav-parent'] — URL stays at /dashboard. Mitigation: bump .cck-bottomnav z-index (currently z-40) to z-[60] or adjust badge wrapper, OR add right-padding to nav grid so the badge sits in the gap. Production environment without the preview badge is unaffected.
